text:
Hi! we had an appointment in Tel Aviv on June 15 to change my partner's status to A5. At the appointment, he was given a temporary Teudat Zehut, and we were told that within two weeks we would receive a call or text from the post office with instructions on where to pick up the ID.

Wanted to see if others also recently waited longer than two weeks? It has now been three weeks, and we haven't received any call or text. Should we contact misrad hapnim to check on the status, or should we continue waiting?
